title: Bitcoin ‘never crossed’ $100K if adjusted for inflation, says Alex Thorn
summary: Galaxy’s Alex Thorn says Bitcoin's $126,000 peak translates to $99,848 after being adjusted for inflation, falling short of its milestone six-figure mark.

title: Amplify ETFs for stablecoins, tokenization go live for trading

title: Solana treasury Upexi slides 7.5% on $1B shelf registration filing
summary: Shares in Upexi fell 7.5% on Tuesday after it filed a $1 billion shelf registration, suggesting its Solana holdings could again grow after over five months of no purchases.
